messages:
alex: FYI — partial allocation for order RW-OP-2197 arrived at EU dock this morning. Customs flagged 3 GPUs with serial/packing mismatch as potential DOA. Need routing plan + cost impact asap. AWB: `GB123456789`
NexaSupply: Sorry to hear that, Alex. We see 6 units shipped on our manifest for RW-OP-2197. Can you confirm which 3 serials are flagged? We'll open an RMA and request photos. Replacements from CN factory are ~3–4 weeks standard, or we can try an expedited split from US stock.
alex: Uploading photos now. Serial list from pallet scan: `SN-A1B2C3`, `SN-A1B2C4`, `SN-A1B2C5` (those three are mismatch).
logistics-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-34211. Status: awaiting vendor confirmation + photos.
maya: If we lose 3 units we drop below our QA reserve for eu-west-1 by about 18% of active capacity. Can we hold 2 spares from the US batch until this is resolved?
NexaSupply: We can hold 2 units from the US pool and do a 2-unit air split to EU. Estimates: freight (air) $4,200, export docs $120, brokerage ~$700. Expedited ETA ~5 business days once we get export approval. Standard (factory replace) ETA 3–4 weeks. Customs risk remains if paperwork not aligned.
igor: If the split goes US->EU we'll need Nexa to import under your EU EORI to avoid Redwood opening a new import. Otherwise VAT+duty hold could delay 5+ days. Nexa, can you confirm EORI and HS code?
NexaSupply: Confirming — EU EORI: NL123456789B01. HS Code: `8471.70.9000`. Declared unit value per invoice: $12,500. We'll provide proforma for customs. Also requesting the DOA photos and packing photos (side/top) to speed RMA.
sarah: On credits: if units are DOA on arrival, what's the crediting timeline? We need a proforma revision to adjust invoice for accounting / VAT. Also, who covers the expedite freight if we ask for split?
NexaSupply: Standard credit for verified DOA: full unit value within 30 days after RMA approval. Expedited freight cost would be chargeable to Redwood unless NexaSupply agrees to absorb (we can discount 50% if RMA confirms manufacturing defect). We can issue revised proforma once RMA accepted.
luis: From infra perspective — losing those 3 GPUs reduces our NEU cluster compute by ~18%. Can we temporarily shift two training jobs to us-east staging to keep SLAs? Also what's the node-level replacement compatibility? Are the US spares identical SKU and firmware?
alex: US spares are same SKU but need firmware alignment; we'll schedule a quick firmware sync on arrival. Agree on shifting non-latency-sensitive jobs to staging.
maya: Also flagging that if we route US->EU we may need additional insurance for higher declared value. NexaSupply, can you confirm insurance terms for split?
NexaSupply: We insure shipments up to invoice value under our standard carrier policy. For high-value split we can bump to door-to-door coverage for +0.6% of declared value.
igor: Logistics checklist for split shipment requested from NexaSupply: 1) photos uploaded to RMA, 2) proforma w/HS and invoice value, 3) AWB for split, 4) carrier ETA, 5) insurance confirmation. Once we have those we can sign off import side.
NexaSupply: Understood — will upload photos and proforma by EOD CET, and confirm insurance + AWB in follow-up.
alex: Thanks. One more ask — if DOA confirmed, please prioritize credit + replacement path. If expedite cost >$5k, we'll need GL approval from finance before booking.
sarah: noted. If expedite freight exceeds $5k we need pre-approval; otherwise charge to PO RW-OP-2197. We'll wait for final quote.
logistics-bot: Reminder: attach images as files to the RMA ticket. RMA-34211 awaiting vendor attachments.
NexaSupply: Uploaded photos and provisional proforma to RMA-34211. Proforma snippet:
```
Items: 3x GPU-RTX-64GB
HS: 8471.70.9000
Unit value: $12,500
Total: $37,500
Insurance uplift option: 0.6% = $225
Expedite freight estimate: $4,200
Brokerage: $700
```
alex: Received — we'll review and circle back within 2 hours. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
igor: I'll prepare an emergency capacity plan and ping infra on reassignments.
luis: I'll standby to accept spares into staging and run firmware sync when they arrive.
maya: please cc me on the final AWB so we can trigger customs pre-alert.
sarah: once NexaSupply confirms whether they absorb any freight portion, finance will confirm approval process.
NexaSupply: We'll reply with final quote in 90 mins after checking US stock and carrier slots.
alex: Good progress. Keeping thread open — will update after RMA confirmation and quote.
